Granny\'s Knees is a playful weather-sensitivity indicator, not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a forecast of how you\'ll feel. Weather is only weather.
Granny\'s Knees is designed to keep your information on your devices, not send it to the app\'s developer.

To get a forecast, your phone sends the coordinates and time zone of your selected city to Open-Meteo. It downloads temperature, humidity and air pressure information and calculates the knee-weather index on your phone.

Your chosen city, downloaded forecast and calculated index are stored or used locally. Future symptom journal entries are intended to stay on your phone or paired watch, rather than being uploaded to a developer server.
The app is designed without developer-operated user accounts, advertising trackers or analytics. Your symptom information is not sent to the developer.

Open-Meteo receives the requested coordinates and can see technical connection information, such as your public IP address. That information goes to the weather provider, not to the Granny\'s Knees developer.
A future version may share information between your paired phone and watch. Watch synchronization is not part of the current Android release.
Android may back up some app data depending on your device settings and the app\'s backup configuration. We are reviewing backup behaviour before the Play Store release.
The weather index is experimental, not medical advice. A complete privacy policy will be provided before public release.
